cues: The poem comes from Under Milk Wood, a radio play first broadcast in nineteen fifty four.
It follows one spring day in an invented Welsh seaside town called Llareggub, a name which, read backwards, is a rude joke: Thomas loves the place but will not sentimentalise it.
The speaker is the Reverend Eli Jenkins, a gentle, poetry writing minister, who recites these verses at his door as the sun goes down.
The title is just the first line.
